text: Door distance marker ('Door 1 m') is drawn on top of the controls hint box text at the quarters exit; the controls hint also stays up long after the player has started walking.

Ines greets 'Morning, doc!' unprompted (tick 2686, 'Come up to the bridge, the view is ridiculous') and then again 'Morning, doc.' on the bay intercom (tick 4008). The first line reads as if she is on the bridge, though she is in the capsule bay and stays there. Repeated greeting + 'come up' wording is slightly confusing about where she is.

Stale hint: at tick ~4900, standing at the bridge doorway (bridge 2.4 m ahead), WREN says 'The bridge is forward, Doctor. Out of your door, turn right, and follow the corridor.' The player left the quarters long ago; the nudge is a timer-based hint that ignores position. (Subtitle had already faded by this shot.)

Probe console stat 'every 10 M' uses an unexplained unit 'M' (mass units of time) on the very first console a new player sees; 'r_s' is glossed ('ten horizon radii') but 'M' is not. The '~6 s' helps, but the big number reads as '10 M(illion?)'.

Out-of-order line: WREN says 'First item on today's plan: drop beacon probe K-1 and log its signal.' at tick 5646, just AFTER the player already pressed 'Launch Beacon K-1' (~tick 5610). The briefing line arrives late, as if the player had not done it yet. Also the objective 'Drop the beacon probe' does not tick off on launch.

Game ran at ~4-20 ticks/s (fps 10) for the whole session with machine load average ~55; a 30 s dream took ~110 s real, and the probe fall would take many real minutes. Probably host contention, not the game, but the walk speed felt sluggish as a result.
